# ChartAnnotationKind

`Flare.Components.ChartAnnotationKind`

The kind of overlay a ChartAnnotation draws.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HorizontalLine` | `0` | A horizontal line at Y (a target or threshold). |
| `VerticalLine` | `1` | A vertical line at X (category index, or X value on scatter). |
| `HorizontalBand` | `2` | A shaded band between Y and Y2. |
| `VerticalBand` | `3` | A shaded band between X and X2. |
| `Segment` | `4` | A free line from (X,Y) to (X2,Y2) in data coordinates. |
| `Arrow` | `5` | A Segment with an arrowhead at (X2,Y2) - a trend or a callout leader. |
| `Point` | `6` | A marked point at (X,Y) with an optional label. |
